description_en: Retrieves the result of a document parsing task
description_zh: 获取文档解析任务的结果
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-doc-parser-job-result --dts-job-id dts-20250729-y0zz3t13h7d0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --rag-instance-id dtsgbe12he619iy801 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDocParserJobResult

parameters.help_en: The task ID (DtsJobId) returned when the document parsing task was created
parameters.help_zh: 创建文档解析任务时返回的任务ID（DtsJobId）
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the task. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DTS RagFlow instance
parameters.name: rag_instance_id

ContentList.description_en:
The complete text parsing content.
If the task type is content, ContentList splits the original document by page. Each page has a separate Markdown text entry
ContentList.description_zh:
完整的文本解析内容。
如果是content类型的任务，ContentList中会将原始文档按页拆分，每一页会有一个单独的Markdown文本信息

items.description_en: Each object contains the page number and the parsed Markdown text of the corresponding page
items.description_zh: 每个object中有页码和每个页码内容解析后的Markdown文本

Content.description_en: The text content of the corresponding page, which is the complete Markdown text after parsing
Content.description_zh: 对应页码的文本内容，解析之后的完整Markdown文本

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be deprecated
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

FileUrl.description_en:
The OSS download URL of the file.

If the task type is zip, this field returns the download URL of the zip package. The URL is valid for 30 minutes
FileUrl.description_zh:
文件的OSS下载地址。

如果是zip类型的任务，该字段会返回zip包的下载地址，地址有效期为30分钟

OuterFileUrl.description_en: The public OSS download URL of the file
OuterFileUrl.description_zh: 文件的 公网OSS 下载地址

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
